properties.name: brix.service.name
properties.description: Service name used during host registration. Recommended format: brix-service-{domain}

properties.name: brix.service.base-url
properties.description: Host gateway base URL used for service registration and heartbeat requests

properties.name: brix.service.registration-enabled
properties.description: Whether service registration is enabled. Enabled by default

properties.name: brix.service.registration-retry-count
properties.description: Maximum retry count when service registration fails

properties.name: brix.service.registration-retry-interval
properties.description: Delay before retrying a failed service registration

properties.name: brix.service.route-scan.enabled
properties.description: Whether route scanning is enabled. Enabled by default

properties.name: brix.service.route-scan.base-packages
properties.description: Base packages to scan. If unspecified, the default plugin package space is scanned

properties.name: brix.service.route-scan.exclude-patterns
properties.description: Excluded path patterns. Matching routes are not registered

properties.name: brix.service.route-scan.include-actuator
properties.description: Whether actuator endpoints are included. Disabled by default

properties.name: brix.cors.enabled
properties.description: Whether CORS support is enabled. Enabled by default

properties.name: brix.audit.enabled
properties.description: Whether audit logging is enabled. Enabled by default
